recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If FM wants future harmonization of EOB cardinality or a restored ClaimResponse insurance-level reference, handle it as a new tracker because it would alter long-published behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-17656 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FM change request for STU3 asking to move the preauthorization reference for ClaimResponse and ExplanationOfBenefit from insurance-level placement to root-level representation, with a root-level field added rather than making an unsafe removal.
initial_application: The issue was applied in August 2018 tracker commits 056a20b34652ecc196253948abcb3cf2e2a14067 and cd41718346186cc9bcfcbd35e62113863824122d, then carried forward in the November 2018 financial-management bulk commit afb5ec66f68641293bb7950b6e0eeb118fa1444a that explicitly listed FHIR-17656.
additional_context: The direct 2018 Zulip discussion explains that ClaimResponse's authorization number belonged at the resource root and that the cut-and-paste problem was on preAuthRef, not on insurance cardinality. Published R4, R4B, and R5 profile JSON keep ClaimResponse.preAuthRef at 0..1 and EOB preAuthRef entries at 0..*, while later FHIR-18083, FHIR-22662, and FHIR-40082 work preserved the root/insurance distinction while adding related period and item-level reviewOutcome structures.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Narrowing ExplanationOfBenefit.preAuthRef or re-adding ClaimResponse.insurance.preAuthRef would be a new substantive work-group decision, not a clearly missing application of FHIR-17656.

related_jiras.note: Added root preauthorization effective-period semantics for the same ClaimResponse/EOB preauthorization response area and was already represented on the combined branch.
Added item-level preAuthRef/preAuthPeriod reviewOutcome structures while preserving root-level preAuthRef semantics.
Completed and normalized the FHIR-22662 reviewOutcome structures for ClaimResponse and ExplanationOfBenefit.
